name: IC Importer – Import posts and pages from google spreadsheet
author: ITclan BD

sections.description:
IC Importer is a lightweight and user-friendly WordPress plugin that allows you to quickly import Posts and Pages from an Excel spreadsheet using an intuitive drag-and-drop field mapping interface.

Whether you’re migrating content, bulk uploading articles, or updating existing pages, IC Importer makes the process simple, fast, and reliable—without requiring any coding knowledge.

Simply prepare your spreadsheet, map the columns to WordPress fields, and import your content within minutes.

Why Choose IC Importer?

  • Import WordPress Posts and Pages in bulk
  • Simple drag-and-drop field mapping
  • Import content from Excel spreadsheets
  • Update existing posts and pages
  • Beginner-friendly interface
  • Fast and lightweight
  • No coding required

Supported Post Fields

IC Importer currently supports importing the following post fields:

  • Post Title
  • Featured Image (Thumbnail)
  • Content
  • Excerpt
  • Categories
  • Tags
  • Author
  • Publish Date

Supported Page Fields

The following page fields are supported:

  • Page Title
  • Featured Image (Thumbnail)
  • Content
  • Author
  • Publish Date

How It Works

  1. Prepare your Excel spreadsheet.
  2. Upload the spreadsheet.
  3. Map your spreadsheet columns to WordPress fields using drag-and-drop.
  4. Start the import.
  5. Your posts or pages will be created automatically.

Updating existing content is also supported, making it easy to keep your website synchronized with your spreadsheet data.

IC Importer

The easiest way to import WordPress posts and pages from Excel or spreadsheet files.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to IC Importer from the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Upload your spreadsheet.
  5. Map the fields.
  6. Start importing.
sections.faq:
Do I have to add an author name?

No, It’s not required. You can add an author name or if you leave the author field empty, then the posts will import under the current user

Can I import both Posts and Pages?

Yes. You can import both WordPress Posts and Pages.

Can I update existing Posts or Pages?

Yes. The plugin allows you to update existing posts and pages instead of creating duplicates.

Is the Author field required?

No. If the Author column is left empty, the imported content will be assigned to the currently logged-in user.

Is the Publish Date required?

No. If no publish date is provided, WordPress will use the current date and time during import.

Can I import Categories and Tags?

Yes. Categories and Tags can be imported. If multiple values are needed, separate them with commas in your spreadsheet.

Can I import Featured Images?

Yes. The plugin supports importing featured images (thumbnails).

Does the plugin require coding knowledge?

No. IC Importer is designed for beginners and advanced users alike. The drag-and-drop mapping interface makes importing simple.

Will the plugin slow down my website?

No. IC Importer is lightweight and designed for efficient bulk imports.

Does it work with the latest version of WordPress?

The plugin is regularly updated and tested with the latest supported versions of WordPress whenever new releases become available.
